title: spring.outbox
description: Transactional outbox relays: one entry per relay instance, each draining one gorm database's outbox_message table to a messaging binder.

db.description: The *gorm.DB bean name backing the outbox table. Empty autowires the single *gorm.DB bean.

binder.description: The messaging binder name (as registered by the broker starter, e.g. kafka, nats). Required.

auto-migrate.description: Create the outbox_message table at startup. Off by default; create it from the documented DDL when managing schema externally.

poll-interval.description: Wait between polls when the table is drained. Minimum 100ms.

max-attempts.description: Total delivery attempts before a record is dead-lettered.

backoff-base.description: Retry wait after the first failure; doubled per further failure.

dlq-suffix.description: Appended to a destination to derive the dead-letter destination. Empty disables the DLQ copy.
